card.name: Short linking words in label instructions
card.fires_on: Small words like from, with, each, first, all, use that sit in the middle of a product-label instruction. Often they come right before a color range, a dose day, or a per-tablet amount.

modes.label: Color variation wording
modes.description: The word from or may vary from before a color range such as pale yellow to yellow.
modes.example: to administration, whenever solution and container permit. COLOR VARIATION<< FROM>> PALE YELLOW TO YELLOW IS NORMAL AND

modes.description: The word Each starting a sentence that gives strength per tablet after a phenylalanine warning.

modes.label: Dose-schedule and use words
modes.description: Words like first, with, or use inside dosing or handling instructions.
modes.example: acute exacerbations of chronic allergic disorders, the following dosage schedule combining parenteral and oral therapy is suggested: Dexamethasone sodium phosphate injection,<< first>> day , 4 or 8 mg
